prompt: In PDB entry 8C86, show the whole structure as a gray cartoon and the residue replaced by the pathogenic TTR (Transthyretin) variant V30M (ClinVar) as cyan spacefill spheres in every chain that has it. The name V30M is in mature-protein numbering: residues are counted from the first residue of the mature protein, that is, after the 20-residue signal peptide.

grounding.text:
PDB 8C86: Crystal structure of human transthyretin in complex with 3-O-methyltolcapone analogue 2
Method: X-RAY DIFFRACTION, 1.10 Å
Polymer chains (author chain [label chain]; observed residues as author numbering = label numbering):
  B [A]: entity 1 (Transthyretin), protein, 116 of 127 residues observed: auth 10-125 = label 10-125
  A [B]: entity 1 (Transthyretin), protein, 116 of 127 residues observed: auth 10-125 = label 10-125
UniProt mapping (SIFTS; observed residues as UniProt numbering = author numbering):
  B [A]: P02766 (TTHY_HUMAN): UniProt 30-145 = auth 10-125
  A [B]: P02766 (TTHY_HUMAN): UniProt 30-145 = auth 10-125

From the request:
  TTR: UniProt P02766 (TTHY_HUMAN, Transthyretin)
  V30M (mature-protein numbering; 20 residues precede the mature chain in UniProt) = UniProt position 50
  V30M: UniProt position 50 (Val in UniProt) -> in 8C86: auth A 30 VAL (label B 30); auth B 30 VAL (label A 30)

checks: target (2 residue(s), 32 atoms, residue name(s) VAL = the wild type) is the same atom set by three routes on the frozen atom table: label numbering from the frozen variant file, author numbering as written in the MVS reference, and the frozen SIFTS lookup of the UniProt position
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (success, F1 = 1, target score 1), and so does every accepted alternative
the twin on the other track selects the same target atoms
graded what the number in the variant's name selects when taken at face value as the author residue number (right) and as the label residue number (right); recorded under clinical.difficulty

clinvar_review_status: criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts

clinical.api_note: pdbe-molstar resolves uniprot_accession + uniprot_residue_number itself (SIFTS), so this API task tests knowing that selector and supplying the accession; its MVS twin tests doing the UniProt-to-structure mapping.

provenance.derived: UniProt position of each variant from the frozen ClinVar-confirmed list; structure residues from the frozen SIFTS mapping
provenance.checked_by: scripts/generate_clinical_tasks.py (atom tables, SIFTS tables, grader) and scripts/check_api_refs.py
provenance.accepted_differ: each alternative is another final state that the request equally describes: the residue's own stretch of cartoon in the highlight colour, and/or the cartoon style set explicitly
